title: Haan Tha Mera Baba
body:
Haan Tha Mera Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Rasn may gale bara aur barhena sar jab
Aaye shaam ke darbar may darida jigar
Pari Sakina pe nagah us shaqi ki nazar
Yazid naam tha jiska sajaye tha darbar
Liye tha godh may dukhtar ko apni woh makkar
Woh apni bachchi ke balon may haath perta tha
Laga ke sine se bachchi ko pyaar se dekha
Lehek ke bali Sakina se shaki bola
Tujhe bhi baba tera eyse hi pyaar karta tha
Kaha Sakina ne may shahedi ki pyaari hoo
Tabaha haal hoo is dum dukho ki maari hoo
Tu mere baba ka gandi zubaan se naam nale
Guror itna nakar bandh ke rasn may hame
Mei kitni pyaari thi baba ki kya bataon tujhe
Mei bhol sakti nahi apne baba ko marke
Mei jab bhi roti thi baba mujhe manata tha
Aray bandha ke haatho ko jula mujhe julata tha
